validation_notes: The right edge (Jul-Aug) shows a tight, flat consolidation around 0.069-0.075 with very low volatility and volume, but there's no clear converging structure - both highs and lows have been roughly flat/horizontal for weeks rather than forming a descending upper trendline with a flat base. This looks more like a low-volatility range/basing pattern after a prolonged downtrend from May, not an active descending triangle. A descending triangle needs distinctly lower highs converging into a flat support; here the highs are also flat, not declining. Insufficient evidence of two distinct converging trendlines with 2+ touches each showing clear compression toward an apex.
